verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud advertises AI-powered features like 'Grafana Assistant', 'Investigations', and natural-language understanding of production systems, and its knowledge-graph feature generates 'insights about issues' connecting metrics/logs/traces — suggestive of AI-assisted incident context. However, there is no explicit documentation describing AI-generated incident summaries specifically for responders during on-call/incident workflows (grafana-docs-19/27 describe incident tooling but without AI summarization detail). Missing for 10: concrete documentation/demo of AI-generated incident summaries, evidence of how Grafana Assistant/Investigations surface summarized alert context to responders, and independent corroboration of this specific capability.
